typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: identity/classification — human review of which LOE this is
typed_core.prompt_hint: This subtype is a fallback; if the letter is clearly about income or property it should have been classified as 077/079 — capture document_title verbatim so a misclassification is visible

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity — whose LOE (flattened from borrower_names person[])

typed_core.name: borrower_name_2
typed_core.why: identity — co-borrower on a joint letter

typed_core.name: borrower_names_raw
typed_core.why: disambiguator — verbatim signer string so a bad split stays visible

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.prompt_hint: The issuer is normally the borrower, not an institution

typed_core.name: recipient_name
typed_core.why: identity — to whom the letter is addressed (lender/underwriter); processor

typed_core.name: issue_orquestion
typed_core.why: processor — the question being answered; the letter's subject line

typed_core.name: reason_or_cause
typed_core.why: processor — the substance of the explanation

typed_core.name: resolution_and_current_status
typed_core.why: processor — whether the matter is resolved (cheap future rule)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Do not infer a resolution the borrower did not state

typed_core.name: accuracy_certification
typed_core.why: processor; presence of the truthfulness attestation

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity linkage (flattened) — ties to the file when stated

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: identity linkage — ties to the loan file when stated

rejected.name: issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: no consumer; issuer is the borrower

rejected.name: effective_date, expiration_date, statement_period_start/end
rejected.reason: a LOE has no coverage period

rejected.name: account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: no consumer on a borrower letter

rejected.name: involved_parties, relevant_dates, relevant_amounts_orreferences, facts_and_chronology
rejected.reason: no rule; catch-all captures the narrative

encoding_variations: accuracy_certification is catalog boolean — issuers write it as a sentence ('I certify the above is true...'), not a checkbox. Degrade to str; the presence and wording matter more than a T/F.
issue_orquestion may appear as a 'RE:' subject line or only in the body — capture whichever is present.
Name may differ between body and signature — borrower_names_raw preserves the signature form.

Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

because this is the fallback LOE, document_title should be retained verbatim so downstream can detect a document that belongs in a more specific subtype

notes: No rules in the packet → no rule floor. This is the catch-all LOE subtype: an unstructured borrower letter about anything not covered by the income/property variants. The typed core stays deliberately thin — identity + the issue + resolution — and lets the narrative body fall to the catch-all. Every field is justified by identity or processor review.
loan_number (confidential) treated as identity/linkage, not registered. No SSN/DOB/account number on this document type.
Ambiguity: signature_date is described as 'execution', which is not one of the five reason_class values; classified as processor as best guess.
